dog.description_text:
💕 MEET TIMON! 💕
🐶 Male | 11 weeks old | Mixed Breed
⚖️ Expected adult size: possibly 30–40 lbs.
Those sweet eyes belong to Timon, an adorable little guy who is ready to leave his rough beginning behind and find the family he was meant to have. ❤️
Timon and his siblings were found abandoned. We may never know why someone left these babies behind, but thankfully they were rescued and given the chance they deserved.
Timon can be a little unsure when he first meets someone new,
dog.name: TIMON
